contexts.text: There are many methods of vexations (there)... The purifying of the blood, and of the chyle... represents these vexations, which are effected by various castigations... After Spirits have been vexed, they are commonly let into a tranquil state... SE 1015.
The food in the stomach is vexed in many ways... and it is further vexed in the intestines. Such vexations are represented by the first vexations of Spirits. Described.
This cleansing is effected by vexations, which are... temptations of various kinds.

Vexator Spirits (of the gall-bladder) distressed him miserably... The vexator Spirits were of those who despised virtue and piety... One kind of vexation there consisted in forcing a Spirit to speak faster than he thought. Explained. SE 1014, Described.
(Another class of Spirits who vex evil Spirits. Described.) SE 3835.
Infernal Spirits by whom men were vexed. Illustrated.
Those who had despised and persecuted things which are good... and true...
The three degrees of... vexation. Enumerated.
That vexations and therefore purifications are innumerable. General article. SE 1741:2.
This is why Souls must, through sufferings, put off all that is not in equilibrium.
After many vexations, they contract fear and horror...
After they have long been vexed by such, they... come among the upright.
